conversation_summary: The shopper is looking for a lightweight and breathable T-shirt for hot summer days, standing at 170 cm tall and preferring a wide fit, possibly sizing up for a looser feel. They initially showed interest in a sand color but are now prioritizing practicality over sustainability. The T-shirt is made of 70% certified organic cotton and 30% TENCEL™ Lyocell, highlighting softness and breathability. The shopper confirmed their intent to purchase but is not ready to finalize the transaction yet. They inquired about care instructions, which involve washing in cold water inside-out and line drying. Budget concerns were mentioned but not detailed. The conversation remains open for future assistance, as the shopper seeks more information on fit options. They indicated they would leave but are open to returning for further inquiries.
